units.source_text: 岛村无端回过头，朝着与驹子相反的方向望去。

en.t: For no apparent reason, Shimamura turned his head and looked in the direction opposite Komako.

units.source_text: 岛村坐来的那辆汽车的车辙，清晰地留在雪地上，在星光下，意外地拖到很远的地方。

en.t: The tire tracks of the car Shimamura had arrived in lay sharply on the snow, stretching unexpectedly far under the starlight.
